newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi national for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi national for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday beheaded a Saudi man for murdering another Saudi is a dispute, raising to 63 the number of people put to death in the conservative Islamic kingdom this year.
An interior ministry statement carried by the official Saudi television said the man was found guilty of stabbing the victim to death. He was beheaded in the southwestern Asir region.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals. It executed a total of 68 people in 1996.
